name: test_dataset_service.py
summary: Unit tests for DatasetService focusing on schema validation error handling during dataset creation.
purpose: Validates that DatasetService correctly detects invalid schemas during dataset creation and appropriately marks errors, ensuring data integrity and preventing corrupt datasets from entering the system.
responsibilities: Test error marking behavior when schema validation fails in DatasetService.create()
Isolate service logic using mocks for external dependencies and models
Verify interactions between DatasetService and the Dataset model during failure scenarios
Provide regression protection for dataset creation error handling paths
inputs: Mocked Dataset model and schema objects
outputs: Boolean pass/fail assertions on error state marking
Verification of mock interactions and side effects
Regression signal for dataset creation failure handling
architecture_notes: Implements isolated unit testing using pytest and unittest.mock to test DatasetService in isolation from persistence and infrastructure layers. Follows the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern and supports Test-Driven Development (TDD) by verifying domain service behavior independently of the Django ORM or external validators.
improvements: Expand coverage to include successful dataset creation and edge cases
Add parameterized tests for various schema failure types
Extract common mock setups into pytest fixtures for reusability
Assert on specific error messages or exception types, not just error marking
Add tests for idempotency and transaction rollback on failure
